Label: Requested
Description: Service request has been submitted and is awaiting handling. Initial status of a Service Request case.

Label: Ongoing
Description: CiviCRM core 'Open' status, labelled 'Ongoing'. Managed here only to enforce its display order and grouping.

Label: Urgent
Description: CiviCRM core 'Urgent' status. Managed here only to enforce its display order and grouping.

Label: Resolved
Description: CiviCRM core 'Resolved' status. Managed here only to enforce its display order and grouping.

Label: Onboarded
Description: Successful end state of an onboarding case. Set automatically when the beneficiary's EU-Survey is imported and matched to the case.

Label: Declined
Description: Closed/rejected end state of an onboarding case.
